scope.dimension_transport: U32; negatives and values above 4294967295 are rejected, never wrapped
scope.layout: materialized logical row-major; no alias or stride contract

exact_words.finite: exact 32-bit words, including signed zero and subnormals
exact_words.nan: require NaN classification; record payload/sign/quiet bit as observation, not portable equality
exact_words.independent_reference: raw input words and independent row-major coordinate mapping

bounded_elementwise.domain: finite normal or zero inputs with abs(value) <= 16; finite outputs; no intermediate overflow
bounded_elementwise.acceptance: abs(observed - exact mathematical result) <= atol + rtol * abs(exact mathematical result)
bounded_elementwise.independent_reference: exact binary32 input rationals; exact rational arithmetic; separately rounded binary32 RN-even words
bounded_elementwise.pytorch_comparison: also require the same disclosed tolerance against the frozen PyTorch value

reduction_envelope.domain: finite inputs, finite exact result, no overflow in any permitted accumulation; individual terms and sum(abs(terms)) < 2^120; n*u < 1
reduction_envelope.sum_n: input element count (conservative count includes initial +0 addition)
reduction_envelope.matmul_n: 2*K (permits separate product rounding and any binary addition tree; FMA is covered)
reduction_envelope.matmul_add_n: 2*K + 1; append bias as one additional exact term
reduction_envelope.bound: gamma(n) * sum(abs(exact terms)) + n*eta; eta = 2^-150 covers gradual-underflow absolute rounding
reduction_envelope.acceptance: each output's exact rational error <= its serialized exact rational bound; no universal atol/rtol
reduction_envelope.cancellation: serialize abs_sum, exact result, accumulation length, and condition number; exact zero has condition infinite when abs_sum > 0
reduction_envelope.pytorch_comparison: require both implementations independently within the mathematical envelope and abs(Bend - PyTorch) <= 2*bound; an exact-zero bound requires exact real value
reduction_envelope.empty_identity: sum of empty input and matmul K=0 are positive-zero words; no tolerance
reduction_envelope.limitations: not a correctness proof or an accuracy guarantee beyond this declared domain; a large cancellation bound is visible evidence, never a reason to drop a case

ieee_edges.domain: separate named cases outside the bounded domain: NaN, infinity, signed zero, subnormal, overflow
ieee_edges.finite: single elementwise results require exact RN-even binary32 words; deterministic identity reductions require explicit words
ieee_edges.nonfinite: require NaN or signed-infinity classification independently of any numerical tolerance
ieee_edges.nan_payload: retain observed words; do not equate payloads or silently filter them
ieee_edges.overflow: only cases with an independently unambiguous overflow classification; no order-dependent overflow reduction acceptance
ieee_edges.underflow: gradual underflow required; flushing subnormals is not an accepted alternate backend

exact_golden.acceptance: exact words as well as exact rational mathematical result

expected_errors.acceptance: explicit semantic category; no allocation or arithmetic before rejected rank/capacity; no silent coercion
expected_errors.dtype_boundary: unsupported dtype errors apply to a dynamic tagged interface if it exists; an F32-only typed API must instead be tested by the root's compile-negative runner
expected_errors.precedence: rank before capacity; coordinate rank before coordinate bounds; matmul rank before inner dimensions

authority: PyTorch is observed reference evidence, not the sole specification; exact rational arithmetic, row-major maps, IEEE classifications, and mathematical goldens are independent.
change_control: Any change to domain, tolerance, classification, operation scope or backend requires a new policy version and reviewed corpus regeneration; never tune after Bend results.
